_comment: What the register's OSV parser MUST extract from each record in
osv-records.json. These are assertions, stated by hand, not computed
from the records - a fixture that derives its own expectations proves
nothing, because the same bug would produce both sides.

severity null means OSV published none. By the rule recorded in
FOLLOWUP.md line 186 dated 2026-08-20, unknown counts as high. That is a
decision, not a defect. It is stated here so a test pins the decision
